speaker: Patient

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis.

The IgG4 level is significantly elevated at 145 mg/dL (normal <135), and ESR is high, which, combined with your history of ulcerative colitis and the ultrasound showing thickened bile ducts, strongly supports this diagnosis. This condition often causes obstruction due to inflammation of the bile ducts and can be associated with other autoimmune diseases like ulcerative colitis.

I have reached my diagnostic conclusion based on the clinical evidence provided.
